description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: 49ers WR Christian Kirk (calf) is officially active for a Week 7 matchup with the Falcons.
items.impact: Kirk is set to make his debut for the 49ers and could be heavily involved with Deebo Samuel and Mike Evans both out due to injury. Fantasy managers should expect Kirk to see plenty of playing time against Atlanta.
items.title: Christian Kirk (calf) officially active for Week 7

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Dolphins WR Caleb Douglas (ankle) is officially active for Week 7 matchup with the Jets.
items.impact: Douglas has been out of action since Week 2. Prior to his injury, he had seven receptions for 113 yards in his first two NFL games. Fantasy managers should expect him to be involved in the Dolphins' passing attack.
items.title: Caleb Douglas (ankle) officially active for Week 7

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) is officially inactive for a Week 7 matchup with the Dolphins.
items.impact: Hall was expected to test his injured quad in pregame warmups, but will now miss his fourth straight game. Braelon Allen will serve as the primary running back against Miami.
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) officially inactive for Week 7

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Texans WR Tank Dell (knee) is officially active for a Week 7 matchup with the Giants.
items.impact: Dell was considered questionable to play but will suit up for the first time since December 2024. Fantasy managers should expect Dell to have limited fantasy value right now.
items.title: Tank Dell (knee) officially active for Week 7

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Titans RB Tyjae Spears (knee) is officially inactive for a Week 7 matchup with the Browns.
items.impact: Spears continues to deal with a nagging knee injury that will keep him out this week. Tony Pollard will see the bulk of the touches out of the Titans' backfield, with Julius Chestnut serving as the backup.
items.title: Tyjae Spears (knee) officially inactive for Week 7

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Titans WR Calvin Ridley (hip) is officially inactive for a Week 7 matchup with the Browns.
items.impact: Ridley was tagged as questionable as he dealt with a hip injury that lingered throughout the week. His absence will likely open up some playing time for a few depth wide receivers on the roster.
items.title: Calvin Ridley (hip) officially inactive for Week 7

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Browns RB Dylan Sampson (knee) is officially active for Week 7.
items.impact: Sampson was considered questionable to play against the Titans, but will serve as the backup to Quinshon Judkins in a plus matchup against Tennessee.
items.title: Dylan Sampson (knee) officially active for Week 7

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Rico Dowdle (knee) is officially active for Week 7 for the Pittsburgh Steelers against the New Orleans Saints according to Nick Farabaugh.
items.impact: Dowdle will suit up after struggling through limited practice sessions late in the week, offering head coach Mike McCarthy another option out of the Pittsburgh backfield behind Jaylen Warren against the Saints.
items.title: Rico Dowdle (knee) active for Week 7

items.author: Jordan Epp
items.desc: Philadelphia Eagles wide receiver Dontayvion Wicks was ruled out for Monday Night Football against Dallas due to an ankle injury.
items.impact: Wicks did not practice this week, so this does not come as a surprise. However, multiple important players will miss Week 7, including Wicks and wide receiver DeVonta Smith. Quarterback Tanner McKee will rely on a patchwork offense in a divisional matchup.
items.title: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) out for Week 7

items.author: Jordan Epp
items.desc: Philadelphia Eagles wide receiver DeVonta Smith has been ruled out for Monday Night Football in Week 7 against the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: This is how the week trended, with Smith not practicing at all heading into Week 7. Smith had returned after a multi-game hiatus for Week 6, catching a touchdown from quarterback Tanner McKee; now, McKee will be without a key offensive weapon.
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) ruled out vs. Dallas

items.author: Jordan Epp
items.desc: Baltimore Ravens quarterback Tyler Huntley is expected to start against the Cincinnati Bengals in Week 7.
items.impact: Lamar Jackson (ankle) remains out despite logging three limited practices this week. Huntley gets at least one more start, with Jackson potentially returning in Week 8. Huntley has three touchdowns in two starts and is a QB2 option against an improved Bengals defense.
items.title: Tyler Huntley set to start vs. Bengals

items.author: Jordan Epp
items.desc: The Baltimore Ravens have ruled out quarterback Lamar Jackson for their Week 6 matchup with the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: Jackson last played on Oct. 4 against the Tennessee Titans, throwing for two scores and 222 yards in one half. The Ravens are 1-1 in that stretch, with Tyler Huntley starting under center. A key divisional matchup awaits in a competitive AFC North, and Jackson could return in Week 8 against the Buffalo Bills.
items.title: Lamar Jackson (ankle) ruled out for Week 7

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Sauce Gardner (calf) will miss Sunday's game against the Vikings.
items.impact: Gardner sustained a calf injury in Week 6 and has been missing at practice all week. Justin Walley and Cam Taylor-Britt will likely see increased snaps in Gardner's absence.
items.title: Sauce Gardner (calf) will not play in Week 7

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Divine Deablo (arm) will miss Sunday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Deablo sustained a forearm injury against the Bears in Week 6 and will not be able to go on Sunday. Josh Woods will step in for Deablo.
items.title: Divine Deablo (arm) will not play in Week 7

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Antoine Winfield Jr. (rib) will miss Sunday's game against the Panthers.
items.impact: Winfield did practice in a limited fashion this week, but he will still miss a third straight game. Ifeatu Melifonwu will step in at safety once again.
items.title: Antoine Winfield Jr. (rib) will not play Sunday

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Zach Charbonnet (knee) will not play Sunday night against the Chiefs.
items.impact: There was some speculation that Charbonnet would make his long-awaited return for the Seahawks on Sunday night, but that will not be the case. Charbonnet was activated from the PUP list this past Thursday and should be ready to go for a Monday night matchup against the Bears in Week 8.
items.title: Zach Charbonnet (knee) will not play in Week 7

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: DeShon Elliott (knee) has been activated off IR.
items.impact: Elliott has yet to play this season and only got into five games last season. He has been practicing this week, however, and will return for the Steelers on Sunday against the Saints. Elliott registered 108 total tackles with three fumble recoveries and an interception back in 2024 for the Steelers.
items.title: DeShon Elliott (knee) returning in Week 7

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Azeez Al-Shaair (groin) will play in Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: Al-Shaair was listed on the team's injury report throughout the week due to a nagging groin issue, but it won't stop him from playing in Week 7 and he is now off of the injury report entirely. Houston's defense will be better with him available to suit up and start.
items.title: Azeez Al-Shaair (groin) will play Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Jalen Pitre (shoulder) is unavailable for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: The Texans will be without one of their key defenders on Sunday with Pitre set to be sidelined due to a shoulder issue. Their secondary will be weaker than usual for however long he's out of the lineup.
items.title: Jalen Pitre (shoulder) unavailable for Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Reed Blankenship (concussion/hand) is out for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: As expected, Blankenship is going to be sidelined on Sunday as he continues to recover from a concussion and a hand issue. Houston's secondary will be short-handed while he's out.
items.title: Reed Blankenship (concussion/hand) out for Week 7

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Brevin Jordan (foot) is set to play in Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: Jordan popped up on the injury report in the middle of the week due to a foot issue, but it's not a serious issue and he will play on Sunday. He isn't expected to be a relevant fantasy option anytime soon, however.
items.title: Brevin Jordan (foot) set to play Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: David Montgomery (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: The veteran running back is going to miss another game on Sunday. He's still dealing with a groin issue of some kind, and it remains to be seen how much longer it will leave him sidelined. Woody Marks and Jawhar Jordan will both continue to see more work for however long Montgomery remains sidelined.
items.title: David Montgomery (groin) ruled out for Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Blake Fisher (thumb) will be sidelined for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: The veteran was sidelined at practice all week due to a thumb issue, and it will officially leave him sidelined for Sunday's game against the Giants. Houston's offensive front will be weaker than usual with him out of the lineup.
items.title: Blake Fisher (thumb) sidelined for Sunday
